title: SDW100 2027 Rules — official
claims: The minimum age on race day is 20, and giving false age information on the registration form carries a lifetime ban.

Runners must carry the mandatory kit at all times, with a minimum one hour penalty per missing item, and mandatory gear checks may take place at the start, on route or at the finish; refusing a check leads to disqualification.

Runners must follow the course at all times according to the course markings and the GPX supplied in the pre-race notes; cutting the course carries a time penalty or disqualification, storing supplies along the trail carries a two hour penalty, and leaving an aid station after a cut-off without handing in bib and tracker carries disqualification and a lifetime ban.
